title: Power and Flourishing Laboratory Reconciliation
course_position: After Chapter 12 and governed SUPER PFLAB gate

case.label: Pathway Support System / Student-Success-System
case.purpose: Transfer case distinct from the Chapter 12 Maathai workbook; requires cross-tool selection, sequencing, judgment, repair, and reopening.

chapter12_boundary.rule: CH12 workbook mastery feeds the Lab, but the Lab does not reuse Maathai as its primary case.

organizing_questions.power: Who can shape conditions, options, representation, burden, contestability, authorization, and reopening?
organizing_questions.flourishing: What real forms of agency, security, relationship, learning, development, and opportunity can affected people actually exercise?
organizing_questions.firewall: Power and Flourishing are organizing questions, not Tools 13 and 14.

fsp_under_the_hood.student_facing_rule: Ethics-first. FSP vocabulary appears only when it clarifies an ethical move; students are not required to learn FSP as a separate framework.

governance_rules: The SUPER handoff may supply prior Tool Records, Output Cards, claim ceilings, and carry-forward questions, but it may not choose Tools or authorize the student's conclusion.
Each selected Tool must state what it reveals and what it cannot establish by itself.
Sequence must be justified: later Tools should receive a better map from earlier Tools.
Bounded judgment must distinguish evidence, inference, uncertainty, recommendation, and authorization.
Repair must target diagnosed mechanisms rather than merely state a preferred outcome.
Standing and authorization must identify who may implement, contest, revise, or stop the repair.
Capability effects must include both intended expansion and burdens shifted onto other people.
REOPEN conditions must be concrete enough to trigger reconsideration.
Authorial Return must state what the student now judges, what remains unresolved, and what would change that judgment.
launch_gates: All twelve chapter Output Cards are READY before PFLAB handoff.
All promised case-resource links open successfully.
No dead buttons, links, or affordances.
Student progress persists through refresh and re-entry.
Exported Lab Record contains every required record field.
Keyboard-only path reaches every interactive control.
Mobile layout remains usable without horizontal page scrolling.
All images have meaningful alt text or are explicitly decorative.
Claim ceiling is visible in the final Lab Record.
REOPEN is visible in the final Lab Record.
Authorial Return is visible in the final Lab Record.
Pressbooks CH12 → SUPER PFLAB gate → PFLAB route is verified end to end.
